listing.description:
Space Walk is an experimental first-person science-fiction game built around moving seamlessly from close-quarters survival into large-scale exploration. Begin with a boarding-torpedo assault and fight through a procedural derelict spacecraft, or jump directly into Glyphship Explore and take command of a ship in a generated sector.

On foot, Walk supports procedural city and derelict environments, first-person movement, ranged combat, hostile creatures, mission objectives and multiple gameplay presets. In space, the scale opens dramatically: giant worlds, asteroid fields, salvage, mining, cargo, planetary markets, distress calls, anomalies, ship combat and long-range warp navigation all become part of the same journey.

The Navigation Lattice adds both local tactical navigation and a procedural galaxy map. Players can inspect nearby contacts, worlds and hazards, plot multi-leg routes through discovered points of interest, and travel across a connected network of generated star systems. Cargo, credits, ship damage, visits and missions continue as the player moves between systems.

A public multiplayer gateway can connect explorers to a shared canonical universe with persistent world state, pilot presence, shared missions, battles, invasions, wrecks and salvage. Flight and combat remain primarily client-simulated today: remote ships are presence snapshots and PvP weapon hits are not yet network-authoritative. The standalone browser experience remains playable without that gateway, with local fallbacks for optional assisted systems.

Space Walk is deliberately broad and experimental: part FPS, part procedural space sim, part tactical sandbox. The current alpha is focused on proving that all of those scales can coexist as one continuous playable world rather than separate game modes or disconnected demos.
features: Procedural first-person derelict-hulk assaults with weapons
Glyphship deep-space exploration with giant worlds
Navigation Lattice with tactical sector mapping and a connected procedural galaxy of star systems
listing.summary: A first-person sci-fi action and exploration game spanning derelict-hulk assaults, procedural cities and deep-space Glyphship exploration. Fight, salvage, trade, mine, navigate generated star systems and continue your pilot, cargo, damage, missions and discoveries across a persistent journey.
listing.tagline: Survive the hulk. Take the Glyphship. Explore a living procedural universe.
